title: Arcane Eruption
summary: Arcane Eruption is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a chance to  Knockdown nearby enemies on Energy Orb pickups. The knockdown goes through walls and is not restricted by Line of Sight.
extract:
Arcane Eruption is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a chance to  Knockdown nearby enemies on Energy Orb pickups. The knockdown goes through walls and is not restricted by Line of Sight.
Can be sold for  500.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Gantulyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Pluto Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.

visit here.

History
Arcane Eruption was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Eruption from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Eruption from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Eruption from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 5  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Eruption from Ordis for 3  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 4 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Eruption from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 2  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).

Notes
Universal Orbs created by  Lavos'  Transmutation Probe can trigger Arcane Eruption.
 Equilibrium Health Orb conversion and Energy Motes spawned by  Emergence Dissipate can not trigger Arcane Eruption.
